description: First pass and return conversation with Mysterious Kid.

nodes.speaker: mysteriouskid
nodes.text: You brought detective shoes into an arcade. That is either brave or tired.

options.text: The Gambler said you notice people who do not want to be noticed.
Blondie passed through here, did she not?
I brought you something with sugar and bad judgment.

nodes.speaker: mysteriouskid
nodes.text: The Gambler notices losing streaks. I notice escape routes. Blondie did not stay still for long. Try the Red Light Block if you want the next footprint.

nodes.speaker: mysteriouskid
nodes.text: She looked at every exit before she looked at the machines. People do that when they think staying still is how they get caught.

nodes.speaker: mysteriouskid
nodes.text: Now that is respect. Fine. Underground Garage. Blondie's trail dipped there after the neon block. Follow the engines, not the faces.

conditionalFollowups.speaker: mysteriouskid
conditionalFollowups.text: I gave you the Garage. If that is not enough, then the night is asking for more than either of us should pay.
